notes.title: INZIPID is dead. Long live TRIM!
notes.notes:
Hi!

I have to notify you all that INZIPID development is deeply suspended and almost closed.
I've decided to make a hybrid of two of my project merging them into one.
The game is gonna be called TRIM.

If you disappointed, remove INZIPID from your wishlist, I'll understand.
If you wonder what's gonna happen here next -- stay tuned, TRIM will hit Early Access this summer.

Thank you all for support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30928358/e4f9bac4699614a77f92e5148a64932fd791c4ae.png[/img]

notes.title: INZIPID Demo is released!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam! We've just released [b]INZIPID[/b] Demo here, so feel free to download and try it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30928358/cb70d8af028ddf2c7e7053c585c90e06a35f9db5.png[/img]

There are a lot of things which we will radically change, add, and replace, but the core will be the same as it is in a demo:
[list]
[*] Cinematic plot makes player feel and worry with the main character.
[*] Inspiration from sci-fi novel Prisoners of Power (Arkady and Boris Strugatsky).
[*] INZIPID denies the existence of terms "good" and "evil". There are no simply good and bad guys in the game. Or maybe, there are.
[*] Tragic and perceptible conflict between two races of robots.
[*] Atmosphere of desolation and lifelessness.
[*] No text (except of game menu). No human language speech.
[*] No toolbar, life bar, mana bar, etc. No bars at all. Entire screen is filled by gameplay image.
[/list]
Thank you!
